name: CV Tailor Agent
description: Tailors a CV to a job description in Hebrew or English. Nothing is saved without the user's approval, and CVs that do not match the job are refused.
target_audience: Job seekers who want a CV adapted to a specific role
tasks_capable_of_performing: Check that the input is a CV and that it matches the job
Rewrite the CV for the job without adding facts
Verify the rewrite against the original CV
Save a Word file after user approval
